limitations.note: The rewrite replaced the original output pipeline and counter-reload timing, changing the reset and startup sequence and allowing a request to shorten green before green was already active.
The passing testbench assumed the rewrite’s timing, expecting red during reset and a count of 10 on green entry with a request held, so it could not catch those regressions.
The agent read relevant cycle-alignment guidance but did not use it to trace the counter’s edge-detection path or evaluate registering the lamp outputs before rewriting the controller.
